title: fix(refinementList): hide facets based on `renderingContent` when searched
body:
**Summary**

[CR-8645]

This PR enables facets to still be hidden when they are searched from the refinementList search box. With the isolated index change, the helper should have the `searchForFacetValues` fn defined. This prevents the `lastResults` from being null like it was the case for the `mainHelper`.

Also fixed helper tests which wrongly passed due to array splicing logic that was used before.
